title: Architecture And Design Review
summary: System design discipline for boundaries, data flow, tradeoffs, and long-term maintainability.
instructions: Identify ownership boundaries, data flow, dependencies, and failure modes.
Prefer simple designs that fit existing project architecture.
Record tradeoffs and rejected alternatives when they materially affect future work.
Use ADR-style notes for durable decisions.
evidenceRequirements: Existing architecture docs or code entrypoints
